title: Grateful Dead Live at College Of William & Mary Hall on 1973-09-12
source: Master Soundboard Reels to DAT 16 bit 44.1kHz from ANON Also, a Kind LL member shared uncirculated lo-fi audience tapes to patch a few spots

ai_review.summary: A mellow, average show with a few nice transitions but hampered by splices and intrusive horns; the matrix recording is only fair.
ai_review.review: The performance swings between laid‑back moments—highlighted by the smooth Eyes → Stella segue and a pleasant Bird Song—and sections weighed down by brass that many listeners find distracting. Recording-wise, the mix suffers from audience splices, dropouts, and muffled portions in songs like Bertha, El Paso, Ramblin' Rose and Don't Ease, leaving it only listenable after the early glitches smooth out.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews give mostly average (3‑star) scores with one lower (2‑star) mainly due to horn arrangements; recording issues further drag the overall rating toward a modest three.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Splices from audience sources, early‑show dropouts and muffled audio in several tracks (Bertha, El Paso, Ramblin' Rose, Don't Ease). Overall clarity is uneven but improves after the first half.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall mellow and laid‑back, reminiscent of the 1974 vibe; transitions are generally smooth except for the intrusive horn sections that detract from the flow.
